title: Answer: no account of what life is, whose biomolecules gave quantum states isolation

statements.text: Orch OR takes no position on what life is. Life enters its account as the place where reduction became orchestrated: as biomolecules appeared and grew, their non-polar regions sheltered quantum superpositions from the environment, and assemblies such as microtubules came to compute until orchestrated reduction was reached. Reductions happen in non-biological settings as well, and the review leaves open whether conscious life of an alien kind exists elsewhere.
statements.scope: the 2014 review Consciousness in the universe

sources.quote: As organic biomolecules appeared in primitive biology, non-polar collections of electron resonance rings, e.g. in lipids, nucleotides, and hydrophobic protein pockets, offered protective isolation for quantum superpositions
whether conscious life of a totally alien kind such as this, or some other form of quantum superposition, might be possible, or even probable, somewhere in the universe.
